tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text:
Number of elements from the following that CANNOT form compounds with valencies which match with their respective group valencies is ______.
B, C, N, S, O, F, P, Al, Si

solution.text: $\mathrm{N}, \mathrm{O}, \mathrm{F}$ can't extend their valencies upto their group number due to the non-availability of vacant $2 \mathrm{~d}$ like orbital.
